name: Timeway Palm
description: Strike at the instant the foe's guard is at its weakest and add no more force than needed.

name: Timeway Guard
description: Raise the guard a breath before the blow arrives so it is already settled when it lands.

name: Timeway Step
description: Step on the beat between two strikes where no blow can find the body.

name: Timeway Sense
description: Feel the rhythm of the fight and note when the next opening will fall.

name: Timeway Counter
description: Let a blow pass a moment late then answer in the space it left behind.

name: Timeway Calm
description: Slow the target's sense of the moment until their reactions come a beat too late.

name: Timeway Rinse
description: Rinse a lingering poison from an ally by letting its time run out of the body.

name: Timeway Hold
description: Hold the target in the moment before their next move until they have forgotten it.

name: Timeway Strike
description: Throw the blow that lands at the one instant nothing could oppose it.

name: Timeway Mending
description: Return a wounded ally to the hour before the hurt grew worse and close the wound there.

name: Right Moment
description: Strike at the exact moment natural law gives no defence and no guard can answer.

name: Opportune Tao
description: streams: Tao + Time; walk the Way at its moment of least resistance so the blow lands when nothing can oppose it.

name: Fateway Palm
description: Strike where the decree already says the blow will fall and merely complete it.

name: Fateway Guard
description: Stand where the decree says no blow will land and let the guard rest there.

name: Fateway Step
description: Step along the line already laid for the user and meet no obstacle on it.

name: Fateway Counter
description: Turn a strike to the line where it was always going to miss.

name: Fateway Calm
description: Lay on the foe the calm of one whose end is already decided.

name: Fateway Cleanse
description: Lift a curse from an ally by showing it that it was never part of the decree.

name: Fateway Bind
description: Hold the target to the line the decree gives them and no other.

name: Fateway Strike
description: Strike a mark that fate had already named so the blow cannot miss by a hair.

name: Fateway Mending
description: Mend an ally whom fate has marked to live until the wound is closed.

name: Decreed Bar
description: Hold to the decreed path so firmly that a hostile technique has no way to reach the user.

name: Destined Way
description: streams: Tao + Fate; make the Way and the decree one line and seal the foe upon it with no step aside.
